content.title: 70 Assisted Housing and 10 Free Promotional Housing Units
summary: An 80-home mixed residential scheme in Boudouaou, combining assisted and free promotional housing with ground-floor professional and commercial premises.
The development integrates 70 LPA assisted housing units, 10 LPL housing units and 10 commercial premises across three distinct blocks.
description: The architectural massing is distributed across three blocks: Block A and Block B, each designed as ground floor plus 8 upper floors (R+8), and Block C, designed as ground floor plus 5 upper floors (R+5). Floor plates are configured with four apartments per level, providing a balanced distribution of F3 and F4 typologies.

The scope of execution covers all-trades delivery (TCE), including secondary trades, waterproofing, internal joinery, mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) installations, alongside roads and utility networks (VRD) and external site works to integrate the mixed-use programme.
content.authority: A coordinated residential development where three structural blocks, commercial frontages and site utility networks are executed as a unified urban insertion.

faq.question: What is 70 Assisted Housing and 10 Free Promotional Housing Units?
faq.answer: The development is an 80-home mixed residential scheme in Boudouaou, combining 70 LPA assisted housing units and 10 LPL promotional housing units with ground-floor commercial premises.

faq.question: What are the structural heights and block configurations?
faq.answer: The project comprises three blocks: Block A and Block B are configured as ground floor plus 8 upper floors (R+8), while Block C is built as ground floor plus 5 upper floors (R+5).

faq.question: What was the technical scope of the construction works?
faq.answer: The contract was executed under an all-trades delivery (TCE) framework, encompassing secondary trades, interior finishes, MEP installations, and roads and utility networks (VRD).

faq.question: How are the individual apartment layouts distributed?
faq.answer: Boudouaou combines 70 LPA homes, 10 LPL homes and 10 professional/commercial premises across three blocks with different heights.
